artifacts.name: Figure 1 Pareto plot
artifacts.summary: Quality vs token cost across 5 benchmarks; tinm_a085 is Pareto-best on 4 of 5 panels. Rendered by paper/figures/make_fig1.py from table_pareto.csv.

artifacts.name: 2WikiMultihopQA n=50 results
artifacts.summary: Per-task metrics for the 4 agents on 2WikiMultihopQA n=50. tinm_a085 0.481 best; +0.114 absolute lift over rag_baseline (t=4.03, paired). This is the largest measured effect in the Phase 1 pilot set.

artifacts.name: TINM substrate doc — anchor + EMA mechanism
artifacts.summary: Compressed latent state z_t = anchor (EMA-α of embeddings of user turns). α=0.85. Trajectory persists in PCP v0 thread; anchor + top_terms drive artifact_find ranking.

artifacts.name: Phase 1 tokens-saved measurement (N=1)
artifacts.summary: Self-reported by the founder on the canonical resume question ('what was the biggest effect we measured?'): ~6000-9000 tokens saved vs the alternatives (re-paste, expanded CLAUDE.md, or re-reading paper_section.md). 5-10x cheaper.

artifacts.name: PCP v0 spec — vendor-neutral thread format
artifacts.summary: File-based JSON. Two files per thread (trajectory + artifacts). Stable thread_id across vendors. Designed so Claude Code, openClaw, Cursor, and Claude Desktop can read the same thread.
